style: Cinematic film still, 35mm, rich saturated color, shallow depth of field, no text, no captions, no watermark.
note: v2 cast: one flamboyant disco singer; the wardrobe is what morphs. v1 stills (neutral singer) are kept for history under ids singer-*.

stills.prompt: A flamboyant 1970s disco singer posing center stage, full of swagger. Towering curly afro with gold glitter, oversized gold aviator sunglasses pushed up on the head, a skin-tight silver-and-magenta sequined jumpsuit with enormous flared bell-bottoms and a huge pointed butterfly collar open to the chest, a pink feather boa, gold platform boots, many gold chains. One arm raised, hip cocked. Behind: a mirror-ball, a lit-up multicolor disco floor, beams of colored light through haze. Medium-wide shot, face clearly visible and well lit.

The same singer as the reference image, same face and hair and pose, same disco stage, but the outfit is now a crisp corporate assistant look: tailored pale-grey suit, white shirt, navy tie, lanyard with an ID badge, a headset microphone. The sequins are gone but a single gold chain remains. Same framing.

The same singer as the reference image, same face and afro, same disco stage, now wearing a full bright-red glossy lobster costume: segmented shell torso, giant padded claws on both hands, antennae on a headband, a tail fanning behind. Gold platform boots still on. Striking the same pose. Same framing.

The same singer as the reference image, same face and afro, same pose, now dressed as a flamboyant pirate captain: black tricorn hat with a huge plume, crimson velvet frock coat with gold braid, ruffled white shirt, a cutlass on the hip. The disco floor has become a ship's deck lit by the same colored lights. Same framing.

The same singer as the reference image, same face and afro, same pose, now dressed as a late-night programmer: oversized black hoodie, headphones around the neck, glowing laptop held in one hand, faces lit cool blue. The stage lights have turned to scrolling green code projected through the haze. Same framing.

The same singer as the reference image, same face and afro, now dressed as a gentle therapist: oatmeal knit cardigan, round tortoiseshell glasses, holding a notepad and pen, seated on a leather armchair that sits in the middle of the disco floor. Warm lamp light mixes with the colored disco beams. Same framing.

The same singer as the reference image, same face and afro visible through an open helmet visor, same pose, now in a glossy white-and-gold retro space suit covered in sequin mission patches. The mirror ball has become a planet; stars behind the stage haze. Same framing.

The same singer as the reference image, same face and afro, same pose, now a rhinestone cowboy: white Stetson, white fringed suit covered in rhinestones, turquoise bolo tie, sparkly cowboy boots. Same disco stage. Same framing.

The same singer as the reference image, same face and afro, helmet tucked under one arm, now in full polished silver plate armor with a magenta velvet cape, the armor reflecting the disco lights like a mirror ball. Same framing.

The same singer as the reference image, same face, now an opera diva: towering powdered wig, an enormous crimson ball gown with a massive skirt and gold embroidery, long gloves, one hand to the chest mid-aria. Same disco stage, now with red velvet curtains. Same framing.

The same singer as the reference image, same face visible, but the body is now chrome robot armor with glowing magenta seams, exposed cables at the joints, a tiny antenna in the afro. Same disco stage. Same pose. Same framing.

The same singer as the reference image, same sequined jumpsuit and afro, now alone after hours: sitting on the edge of the empty lit-up dance floor, boa slack across the shoulders, head slightly bowed. The club is dark, the mirror ball still turning slowly, throwing small specks of light across the empty room. Melancholy. Wide shot.
